verdict.rationale: The Minnesota Secretary of State is a government business-filing and UCC-lien registry portal. It offers searches, filings, copy orders and data subscriptions, not user-authored automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this product. The 90-day filing transaction history is a record of completed filings, not version control or rollback for automations, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
